title: VECTOR CALCULUS I
description: Vectors, vector functions, and curves in two and three dimensions. Surfaces, partial derivatives, gradients, and directional derivatives. Multiple integrals in rectangular, polar, cylindrical, and spherical coordinates. Physical and geometric applications.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.

Enrollment limited to students in a Honors Bachelor of Arts, Honors Bachelor of Fine Arts, Honors Bachelor of Music or Honors Bachelor of Science degrees.
